title: CLI board screenshot
description: Humans and agents can list Kanbus issues, but there is no CLI way to capture or share what the board UI looks like. Add kbs console screenshot to write a PNG of the live console board (headless browser against the existing console, not a second renderer). Authoritative behavior spec: features/specs/console/console_screenshot.feature

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Landing screenshot on develop/main for PyPI

Merging existing `kbs console screenshot` (PR #171) into Kanbus and releasing. Not duplicating the feature.

- Rebase/merge `origin/develop` into `cursor/cli-board-screenshot-5624`
- Fix CI (python, rust, python-console-parity)
- Squash-merge #171 to develop with `feat(console): add kbs console screenshot command`
- Follow current ship path: feat PRs go to **main** so semantic-release can bump and publish to PyPI

comments.text: Released kbs console screenshot on main via PR #178; kanbus-py-0.24.0 tagged and publishing.
